items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-kominka-thatched
reasons: Roof share is 34.7%: top outline row 19 to eave outline row 43 is 25 rows, over a bbox of rows 19-90 (72 rows). Rule 1 passes (the old 39.7% is fixed).

Thatch now passes rule 7. Bands are rows 24-27, 28-31, 32-35 and 36-38. The darker separator rows 27, 31 and 35 are broken in places, mixing 7f784b, a09862 and 5f5a38. The strokes are 1px x 2 rows (for example x=21 rows 25-26, x=17 and x=24 rows 29-30), irregularly spaced, and the lower bands are darker.

Ridge cap is boxed dark wood (rows 20-23: a18d76, 705c4a, 593e39, 452b2d). The eave is bfb77f x2 (rows 39-40), then 593e39 (41), 452b2d (42), the outline (43), and one wall-shadow row 8c8371 (44). The hip ends are lighter on the west and darker on the east.
The noren (rows 52-57, x 12-24) is now plain blue; the crest glyph is gone. The front of plaster, posts, shoji, engawa and plinth is a clear south face. It reads correctly at 1x in map 01 at (32,48).
fixes: Optional: the plaster at rows 45-55 is speckled in bright f7f2d3 and bdb793 blotches. That is heavier than the subtle 1-step speckle in rule 9 and on house_hiraya. Thin it to sparse 1px marks one step off the base.
Optional: the checkerboard dither shadow around the step stones (rows 86-90) is not used on the jp_city house anchors. Consider a solid 1-row shadow.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-kawara-farmhouse
reasons: Roof share is 34.8%: rows 11-34 are 24 rows, over a bbox of rows 11-79 (69 rows). Rule 1 passes.

Rule 4 now passes. Only the top 2 courses carry joints (rows 20-21 and 24-25, every 4px). Course 3 (rows 27-30) has no joints, only 3px marks at x 23-25 and 67-69 (44px apart). The eave is 8588ad (31), 465166 (32), 282a3d (33), the outline (34), then a shadow row (35).

Rule 5 fails: there is no onigawara block at either ridge end. The ridge box (rows 12-18, cream noshi row 14) runs straight into the diagonal hip-ridge lines (282a3d/373d52 at x 20-23 on the left and x 75-79 on the right). There is no ~5x6 end block with a light top-left, a dark bottom-right and a dark 1px inner divider. Compare the kura in this same pack (x 3-8, rows 10-15) and house_hiraya (x 20-23, rows 10-14).

The view passes. The hip triangles have vertical 4px stripes, a light west face and a dark east face. The front of plaster, lattice, shoji and plinth is a clear south face, and it reads correctly at 1x in map 01 at (352,64).
fixes: Add an onigawara end block of about 5x6px at both ends of the ridge box (rows 12-17, about x 17-22 and x 73-78). Light a0a2c7 top-left, dark 373d52/282a3d bottom-right, and a 1px 282a3d divider on the inner side, as on the kura in this pack. Let the hip-ridge diagonals start below or outside the block.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-kura-storehouse
reasons: Roof share is 33.8%: rows 9-32 are 24 rows, over a bbox of rows 9-79 (71 rows). Rule 1 passes.

Rule 4 now passes. Only courses 17-20 and 21-24 are jointed. Course 25-28 is unjointed with a single 3px mark at x 23-25. The roof is now a side-on gable with a rectangular silhouette, so hip rule 6 no longer applies. The old charge is cleared.

Rule 5 passes. The ridge box (rows 10-16) has a cream noshi row (12) and proper onigawara at both ends (x 3-8 and x 55-60, rows 10-15) with a light top-left and a dark divider. The eave is 8588ad (29), 465166 (30), 282a3d (31), the outline (32), then a shadow row 7d8592 (33).
The front of white plaster, barred windows, iron door, namako base, plinth and steps is a full south face. The roof reads as a top band at 1x in maps 04 and 06.
fixes: Optional: house_hiraya_gable draws its gable ends with a light verge board (white 1-2px vertical edge) and an eave that is 1px wider than the verge. Here the roof ends are plain ink verticals, so at 1x the roof reads like a lid. A 1px light verge at x 3 and a dark one at x 60 (rows 17-28) would match the exemplar.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-dagashiya
reasons: Roof share is 35.3%: rows 28-51 are 24 rows, over a bbox of rows 28-95 (68 rows). Rule 1 passes.
Rule 4 now passes. Only courses 36-39 and 40-43 are jointed. Course 44-47 is unjointed with 3px marks at x 22-24 and 66-68 (44px apart). The roof is now a side-on gable, so hip rule 6 does not apply.

The ridge box has a noshi row (31) and onigawara at both ends. The eave is 8588ad (48), 465166 (49), 282a3d (50), the outline (51), then a wall-shadow row (52). The signboard (rows 54-62) is a plain yellow and red board with dots, no glyph. The striped awning is fabric and exempt. The candy jars show their caps from above.
Reads correctly at 1x in map 02 at (144,80).
fixes: Optional: the blue disc at x 2-7, rows 76-81 hangs outside the wall line with no post or bracket and reads as a floating ball at 1x. Mount it on a bracket or remove it.
Optional: like the kura, add a light verge on the gable ends.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-wooden-station
reasons: Roof share is 34.7%: rows 19-44 are 26 rows, over a bbox of rows 19-93 (75 rows). Rule 1 passes. The eave is continuous now: 3d151f (40), tip 854a38 (41), 3d151f x2 (42-43), and the outline at 44 across the full width. The old eave-break charge is cleared.

Rule 5 fails: there is no ridge box at all. Directly under the top outline (row 19), rows 20-23 are an ordinary jointed tile course (9e644d, 854a38, then 6b302a with 521e21 joints every 4px). There is no light/noshi/dark ridge box and no onigawara at either end. (Note: the jp-station_small anchor also has no ridge box, but rule 5 is binding for this group.)

Rule 6 fails: the front gable (rows 21-39, x≈40-74) is still a flat brown board triangle. Its only roof is a bright 1px b88165 rake line, drawn diagonally over the front tile courses from x 40 to x 58, plus a dark right rake and a light bottom board at row 39. The rule forbids a bright 1px line over the front courses, and the gable has no tile slopes of its own.

Fronts must look as they do in the exemplars (rule 9), but the white band at rows 48-54 spans x 4-107 while the walls span x 7-104. It sticks out 3px past both wall lines, with ink only on its end caps. At 1x in map 03 at (112,16) it reads as a separate floating slab under the eave, neither a sign flush with the wall nor a canopy with a top.
The 3/4 view itself passes. The hip faces have vertical stripes and light/dark boundaries, and the walls, windows, door and platform form a clear south face.
fixes: Add a ridge box across the top (about rows 20-24): a light 9e644d top row, a cream/noshi row, then 1-2 dark 521e21/3d151f rows. Put onigawara blocks of about 5x6 (light top-left, dark bottom-right, dark inner divider) at both ends. Start the jointed course below it, and keep the 30-36% share (take a row from the lower courses if needed).

Give the front gable its own small roof: two 2-3px tile slopes (verge rows) along both rakes, the left one light and the right one dark, meeting at a tiny ridge at the apex, and its own short eave tip. Or drop the gable and keep the clock on the white sign board. Remove the bare 1px bright rake line over the front courses.
Pull the white band in to the wall line (x 7-104) as a flush sign board. Or, if it is meant as a canopy (hisashi), give it a 2-3 row top plane and the tip/dark/outline eave sequence.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-bus-stop-shelter
reasons: Roof share is 33.9%: rows 2-21 are 20 rows, over a bbox of rows 2-60 (59 rows). Rule 1 passes.

Rule 8 now passes. The ribs run on a 4px period (9f97a8 light, then 817c8c, 817c8c, 646473 dark). A 1-row darker seam 3a3942 sits at row 14, 12 rows below the ridge outline. The eave tip is e6e2f0 (19), then cac7d6 (20), then the outline (21), with no rust. The old missing-seam charge is cleared.

The trapezoid silhouette and the darker east band (x 30-34) read as hip shading, not as a receding side face. The interior, bench, notice board and concrete slab read as a south face. The sign pole has no glyphs.
Reads correctly at 1x in map 02 and map 03 (16,0).

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-waterwheel-mill
reasons: Roof share is 33.9%: rows 7-25 are 19 rows, over a bbox of rows 7-62 (56 rows). Rule 1 passes (the old 36.2% is fixed).

Thatch passes rule 7. The ridge cap is boxed dark wood (rows 8-11). The bands are rows 12-15 and 16-19, separated by broken darker rows 15 (7f784b, broken by a09862 at x 16-18 and x 25-29) and 19 (5f5a38, broken by 7f784b). The 2-row strokes are irregular (x 15, 18, 23 in rows 13-14; x 10, 19, 23 in rows 17-18). The eave is bfb77f x2 (21-22), then 593e39 (23), 452b2d (24) and the outline (25), with a wall shadow at 26.
The wheel faces south with its flume running north (its water is seen from above). The basin shows a water top and a front face. Reads correctly at 1x in map 04 at (480,128).
fixes: Optional: the thatch body is only 8 rows with sparse grain (about 3-4 strokes per band). One or two more irregular strokes per band would match the kominka.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-agri-tin-shed
reasons: Roof share is 34.5%: rows 18-37 are 20 rows, over a bbox of rows 18-75 (58 rows). Rule 1 passes (the old 41.5% is fixed).

Rule 8 now passes. The ribs run on a 4px period (9f97a8 light, 817c8c, 817c8c, 646473 dark). A 1-row darker seam (4e4d59/3a3942) sits at row 30, 12 rows below the ridge outline. The eave is e6e2f0 (35), then cac7d6 (36), then the outline (37), with a wall-shadow row at 38 and no rust.

The dark east zone (x 51-59, rows 19-34) is a triangle widest at the top that ends at the eave corner, a hip face and not a side face. A matching lighter west zone (double light columns at x 8-13, rows 19-24) exists, though it is faint.
The open front bay with machinery and shelving is a clear south face. Reads correctly at 1x in map 04 at (560,0).
fixes: Optional: the east hip face (4e4d59/3a3942) is 2-3 steps darker than the front ribs, while rule 6 asks for one step. The west face is barely distinguishable. Lift the east face one step and make the west face a clear one-step-lighter triangle so the hip reads symmetric.

summary: 6 pass, 2 fail. Every redraw clears its old charge: all roof shares are now 33.8-35.3%, tile joints sit only on the top 2 courses, the thatch has broken separators and irregular grain, the tin roofs have their 12-row seams, and the noren glyph is gone. Remaining fails: kawara-farmhouse has no onigawara at either ridge end (rule 5). wooden-station has no ridge box or onigawara (rule 5), a front gable that is only a bright 1px rake line over the front courses with no slopes (rule 6), and a white band that sticks out 3px past both wall lines like a floating slab. No 3/4-view charge (1-6) and no style charge (8a-8d) holds on any of the eight.
